_comment: Option B — per-entity merged-PR attribution by COMMIT AUTHOR IDENTITY (card_8a25 follow-up). Because every EClaw PR is squash-merged through ONE shared GitHub account (HankHuang0516), GitHub-login counting (entity-gh-login.json) cannot distinguish entities. This file maps entityId -> the git author identities (names/emails/Co-Authored-By trailers) each entity actually commits with, so counts are per-entity. The canonical scheme is `entity-<N>@bots.eclaw` (see docs/specs/per-entity-git-author-spec.md §3-5); the extra emails/names are historical identities derived from real git history of HankHuang0516/EClaw so existing work still attributes. byDevice overrides byEntityId. An entity with NO author identity (only the canonical email, zero history) still renders gracefully (0 with author-source active) instead of the GitHub-login setup hint. Matching is case-insensitive. NOTE: GitHub's commit-search index only covers TOP-LEVEL commit author/committer email, NOT Co-Authored-By trailers — see entity-gh-stats.js header for the accuracy/perf trade-off. coAuthorTrailers is retained for the (heavier) commit-body attribution path and for documentation of the canonical trailer form.
